invariants.description: HMAC-SHA-256 chained append-only monitor ledger. Every MonitorRecord is sealed with an HMAC over (record_id, event_type, timestamp_ns, payload_hash, prev_digest).
invariants.enforcement: seal() raises on missing prev_digest; _append_record always chains

invariants.description: Monitor config changes require HUMAN-0 authorization. update_config() raises ACAMHuman0Error unless human0_authorized=True.
invariants.enforcement: update_config() gate check on human0_authorized flag

invariants.description: Monitor records are immutable once appended. JSONL ledger is append-only; no delete or update operations exist.
invariants.enforcement: No delete/update functions exposed; ledger is append-only

invariants.description: ACAM is strictly read-only — it never mutates the constitution, amendments, or proposals. No write_constitution / write_proposal / ratify_amendment functions exist.
invariants.enforcement: Module API has no mutation functions; test_T218_ACAM_28 verifies absence

invariants.description: Chain integrity verified on every verify_chain() call. _verify_chain_integrity() walks all records and compares HMAC[:24] via hmac.compare_digest.
invariants.enforcement: verify_chain() raises ACAMIntegrityError on any mismatch

invariants.description: Stale-proposal detection uses configurable threshold (default 72h). Only PROPOSED state amendments trigger stale detection. Threshold minimum is 1h.
invariants.enforcement: AmendmentRecord.is_stale() checks state == PROPOSED and age > threshold

invariants.description: Amendment conflict detection fires on every scan. Two or more PROPOSED/RATIFIED/REVIEWED amendments targeting the same section trigger a conflict record. Dual-RATIFIED is CRITICAL severity.
invariants.enforcement: _detect_conflicts() runs on every scan(); severity escalation for dual-RATIFIED

invariants.description: Coverage score is computed from live ACSA ledger data only — never hardcoded. _compute_coverage() derives score = covered_sections / total_sections from live amendment list.
invariants.enforcement: _compute_coverage() always reads live amendment list; no static fallback

invariants.description: Monitor ledger write uses os.replace() for atomicity. All writes go to a .tmp file first, then are atomically renamed.
invariants.enforcement: _append_record() uses tmp file + os.replace(); raises ACAMAtomicError on OSError

invariants.description: All CRITICAL alerts must be appended to the monitor ledger before the scan() response is returned. _append_record() is called before the return statement.
invariants.enforcement: _append_record(record) precedes the return dict in scan(); CRITICAL alerts in payload
